videos.title: How to use AI on a file you can't upload #AI #privacy #productivity #datasecurity #AItools
videos.description: Here is the mental shift that unlocks this. When a file is too sensitive to upload, do not start by asking whether AI is allowed. Start with the job. Ask what the model actually needs to see to help, which is almost never the whole document. It does not need the name, the account number, the salary, the address. It needs the shape of the problem. Once you see that, the move is obvious: make a smaller, stripped-down copy that carries the useful part and none of the sensitive part, and send that.
